content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Kanpur Project Scientist / Project Engineer Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 25-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kanpur Project Scientist / Project Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the IIT Kanpur Project Scientist / Project Engineer positions is 25th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Scientist / Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Project Scientist / Project Engineer positions at IIT Kanpur. This offers a good opportunity for eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have a M.Tech/M.E./M.S./M.Sc./MCA or a B.Tech/B.E./B.S. with 1 year of relevant experience in specified disciplines like Geoinformatics, Civil, Computer Science, etc.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Scientist / Project Engineer roles?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 31,600 to Rs. 78,400, depending on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by IIT Kanpur.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for these positions?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is via email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with necessary documents to the official email address.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection criteria for the Project Scientist / Project Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an online interview. Candidates are advised to prepare well for both stages.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section provided in this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of IIT Kanpur?
faq.answer: The official website of the Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur is www.iitk.ac.in. You can visit this website for more information about the institute and its activities.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for Project Scientist / Project Engineer positions on a contract basis. It is not a permanent government job.
